fullPassage: The decline in the diversity of our food is an entirely human-made process. The biggest loss of crop diversity came in the decades that followed the Second World War. In an attempt to save millions from extreme hunger, crop scientists found ways to produce grains such as rice and wheat on an enormous scale. And thousands of traditional varieties were replaced by a small number of new super-productive ones. The strategy worked spectacularly well, at least to begin with. Because of it, grain production tripled, and between 1970 and 2020 the human population more than doubled. Leaving the contribution of that strategy to one side, the danger of creating more uniform crops is that they are more at risk when it comes to disasters. Specifically, a global food system that depends on just a narrow selection of plants has a greater chance of not being able to survive diseases, pests and climate extremes.

det.korean: 식량 다양성의 '감소(decline)'는 '극심한(extreme)' 굶주림 상황에서 시작됐고, '전통적인(traditional)' 품종이 신품종으로 대체되었다.
det.analysis:
(A) decline(감소): 원문 일치 — 다양성의 '감소'가 인간이 만든 과정
(B) extreme(극심한): 원문 일치 — '극심한 굶주림'에서 수백만을 구하려는 시도

② 대규모로 무언가를 만드는 행위: production(생산)의 뜻
③ 큰 피해를 주는 갑작스러운 사건: disaster(재난)의 뜻
④ 식물과 작물을 해치는 작은 동물·곤충: pest(해충)의 뜻
det.tip: diversity = 다양성 (여러 다른 종류가 존재하는 상태)

questions.passage: The strategy worked spectacularly well, at least to begin with. Because of it, grain production tripled, and between 1970 and 2020 the human population more than __________ (double).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: 과거의 사실을 서술하는 문장이므로 double → 과거형 doubled.
det.analysis: 앞의 tripled(세 배가 되었다)와 같이 1970~2020년 사이에 일어난 과거의 변화를 말하므로, 동사 double(두 배가 되다)을 과거형 doubled로 바꿉니다

questions.passage: Leaving the contribution of that strategy to one side, the danger of __________ (create) more uniform crops is that they are more at risk when it comes to disasters.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: 전치사 of 뒤에는 명사 역할을 하는 동명사가 오므로 create → creating.
det.analysis: 'the danger of ______ more uniform crops'에서 전치사 of 뒤에는 명사 자리이므로, 동사 create를 동명사 creating으로 바꿔 '더 획일적인 작물을 만드는 것의 위험'이라는 뜻을 만듭니다

questions.passage: The decline in the diversity of our food is an entirely human-made process. The biggest loss of crop diversity came in the decades that followed the Second World War. In an attempt to save millions from extreme hunger, crop scientists found ways to produce grains such as rice and wheat on an enormous scale. And thousands of traditional varieties were replaced by a small number of new super-productive ones. The strategy worked spectacularly well, at least to begin with. Because of it, grain production tripled, and between 1970 and 2020 the human population more than doubled. Leaving the contribution of that strategy to one side, the danger of creating more uniform crops is that they are more __________ when it comes to disasters. Specifically, a global food system that depends on just a narrow selection of plants has a greater chance of not being able to survive diseases, pests and climate extremes.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: at risk(위험에 처한). 획일적 작물은 재난이 닥칠 때 더 '위험에 처한다'.
det.analysis:
① in control(통제하는): 문맥 부적합
② at risk(위험에 처한) ←정답: 'they are more ___ when it comes to disasters'로, 재난 앞에서 더 위험함
③ on sale(할인 중인): 문맥 부적합
④ at peace(평화로운): 문맥 부적합
det.tip: more at risk = 더 위험에 처한

questions.passage: The decline in the diversity of our food is an entirely human-made process. The biggest loss of crop diversity came in the decades that followed the Second World War. In an attempt to save millions from extreme hunger, crop scientists found ways to produce grains such as rice and wheat on an enormous scale. And thousands of traditional varieties were replaced by a small number of new super-productive ones. The strategy worked spectacularly well, at least to begin with. Because of it, grain production tripled, and between 1970 and 2020 the human population more than doubled. Leaving the contribution of that strategy to one side, the danger of creating more uniform crops is that they are more at risk when it comes to disasters. Specifically, a global food system that depends on just a __________ of plants has a greater chance of not being able to survive diseases, pests and climate extremes.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: narrow selection(좁은 선택지). 소수의 식물에만 의존하는 '좁은 선택지'가 위험을 키운다.
det.analysis:
① wide range(넓은 범위): 위험이 커진다는 흐름과 반대
② rich variety(풍부한 다양성): 위험이 커진다는 흐름과 반대
③ large amount(많은 양): 문맥 부적합
④ narrow selection(좁은 선택지) ←정답: 'depends on just a ___ of plants'로, 소수 식물에만 의존해 질병·해충에 취약
det.tip: a narrow selection of plants = 소수의 좁은 선택지
